column1: # The realisable bases of the PSP seeded corpus, one per line: id, path from
# the repository root, source, and optionally max_candidates (how many
# candidates seed.py draws; set on the SYNTECH17 lines, where each check
# costs a whole-specification realize). The SYNTECH17 lines are the
# realisable imports, the five with event-delimited slots first; three of
# those have no weakenable guarantee and give no candidate.
